title: Chapter 129: The Cat That Can See Them
html:
Dark clouds pressed low as rain soaked Chen Ge’s jacket. Crouching before the cat, he replayed the confrontation. The shopkeeper had been armed; why had he surrendered so easily?

The sudden terror on the man’s face made Chen Ge wonder what he had seen.

When I grabbed him, cold radiated from my eyes. That must have been the Yin Yang Vision.

The black phone’s description of Yin Yang Vision was vague, and Zhang Ya had blasted half the mirror monster into his eyes. The ability seemed to have evolved, but Chen Ge could not identify how.

I acted on instinct. Perhaps everything that has happened lately is finally getting to me.

Since obtaining the black phone, Chen Ge had scarcely rested. His days revolved around Daily Missions and far more dangerous Trial Missions. Still, the rewards were real: both attendance and reviews for the Haunted House had improved.

The white cat still refused to let him approach, so he did not force it. He sheltered nearby, intending to leave once the storm eased. Ten minutes passed without any sign of the rain weakening.

He shone his phone’s flashlight into the corner. Water was pooling across the dark alley, and the saturated box had begun collapsing from below. When Chen Ge drew closer, he found the injured cat lying beside the four cold kittens, too weak to stand.

I can’t leave it here to die.Chen Ge wrapped the cats in his jacket, hailed a taxi, and rushed to the nearest pet store. Ten minutes later, he arrived as a uniformed woman was locking the door.

“Wait a minute!” Chen Ge did not even open his umbrella and rushed directly toward the girl.

“I’m sorry, we’re closed. Come back tomorrow.” At the sight of the drenched stranger, the woman instinctively stepped back.

“The cat won’t survive until tomorrow. Money isn’t a problem—please save it.” Rain streamed from Chen Ge’s clothes, leaving him a miserable sight.

The woman looked at Chen Ge’s arms. The white cat was covered with mud, and a long wound ran down its face. “A stray cat?”

“Yes.”

“Strays can be wild and attack people. These wounds look man-made, probably retaliation after it hurt someone. Are you certain you want to save it?”

“Yes. Several boys probably killed the kittens. Their mother refused to abandon them even while the boys threw bottles and bricks at her.”

“If you insist, come inside.” She unlocked the door and took the bundle. “The kittens are beyond saving. If you intend to keep their mother, bury them near your home.”

“All right.” Her name tag identified her as Zhao Wen, the store’s owner. While she treated the white cat, Chen Ge sat among the cages and watched the other animals.

Strangely, every animal had fallen silent the moment he entered.

Is there something on me? Or are they sensing Zhang Ya?In a nearby cage, a cat had curled into a tight ball in the farthest corner. The contrast made the white cat’s courage even more impressive.

When he first approached, the white cat had bared its teeth and prepared to fight him to the death.

This stray may surprise me.Xiao Du had said mirror monsters feared cats, which was one reason Chen Ge had decided to adopt it.

Around 11:00 p.m., Zhao Wen returned carrying the white cat and a basket containing the kittens. “She’s surprisingly beautiful. It’s a shame the scar on her face will be permanent.”

Chen Ge barely recognized the snow-white animal in her arms. Its fur was soft and lustrous, but its most striking feature was its mismatched eyes—one red, one blue.

“Why would the original owner abandon such a pretty cat?” Chen Ge thought the cat was pretty as well.

“I don’t mean to frighten you, but adopting strays can be risky, especially one this well bred. Its owner may have abandoned it because of some superstition or an unfortunate incident.” Zhao Wen handed over the cat. “Now that you’re responsible for her, check these smaller wounds every day for infection.”

After paying, Chen Ge returned to New Century Park with the cat and kittens.

“This is your home now.” The moment Chen Ge opened the gate, the previously drowsy cat’s ears snapped upright.

It reacted before we even entered. This cat may truly be useful.He set it beside the entrance and carried the kittens inside. After a long, unhappy howl, the cat reluctantly followed. To test its sensitivity, Chen Ge led it through several scenarios.

The cat behaved normally in Minghun, Murder by Midnight, and Night of the Living Dead. But when Chen Ge removed the boards over Mu Yang High School, its fur stood on end. It leaped onto the stairs and blocked his descent.

Mu Yang High School’s main mission remains unfinished. More secrets may be hidden down there.Whatever the cat had sensed, its warning proved that saving it had been worthwhile.

Closing the board, Chen Ge went over to hug the cat, but the cat jumped away. It seemed to despise human contact.

Basket in hand, Chen Ge returned to the staff break room with the cat following. Only after he shut the door did it relax. It jumped onto a chair and noticed Xiaoxiao hiding beneath the table.

“You little troublemaker.” Chen Ge pulled Xiaoxiao out and held her before the cat. “She’s our friend, so don’t hurt her.”

The white cat showed no reaction at all. Perhaps Xiaoxiao was too weak to interest it.

Xiaoxiao is still a Baleful Specter, yet the cat ignored her completely.Feeling oddly sorry for her, Chen Ge rubbed the rag doll’s head.
